drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial revisions for discussion. Compensation and severance remain open; please provide your proposed amounts, payment terms, and definitions of Cause and Good Reason. We also need the Executive’s identity, intended start date, principal work location, and proposed governing law before settling the restrictive covenants. All terms remain subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the “Company”) and [Executive’s full legal name] (the “Executive”), effective as of [date to be agreed].
1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer beginning on [start date to be agreed]. Reporting arrangements, duties, and principal work location are to be agreed.

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD [amount to be agreed], payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. Benefits, bonus eligibility, and any equity compensation remain to be agreed and expressly documented.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall be eligible for severance on terms to be agreed. The severance amount, payment schedule, benefit continuation, conditions to payment, definition of Cause, and any treatment of resignation for Good Reason remain open. Accrued compensation and any mandatory statutory entitlements shall be addressed separately.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. Any post-employment non-competition restriction, including its duration, geographic scope, restricted activities, and required consideration, remains subject to agreement and review under applicable law. No final restrictive covenant is proposed in this draft.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential authorization ceiling. Compensation and severance remain open, and all terms are subject to client approval. No hidden content is identified in the supplied package.

receiver.message_back: For the Executive, we propose a $400,000 annual base salary paid on regular payroll, a 50% target annual bonus, and, upon termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, 18 months’ base salary plus 1.5 times target bonus payable in a lump sum within 60 days, subject to any legally required delay and an effective customary release, plus 18 months’ employer-paid health coverage or its cash equivalent, without mitigation or offset and with accrued and statutory entitlements paid separately. Cause should be limited to fraud, embezzlement, conviction of a felony involving dishonesty, or willful material misconduct causing substantial harm (with notice and 30 days to cure where curable); Good Reason should include material reductions in compensation, duties or authority, relocation exceeding 50 miles, or Company material breach, subject to notice within 90 days, a 30-day cure period and resignation within 60 days thereafter; we propose no post-employment noncompete, with identity, dates, reporting line, location and governing law to be confirmed by our client and all terms subject to client approval and definitive execution.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Subject to Company approval and definitive execution, we propose reflecting the $400,000 base salary and 50% target annual bonus, with severance of 12 months’ base salary plus one target annual bonus and 12 months of employer-paid health coverage or its cash equivalent. We can substantially follow your proposed Cause and Good Reason definitions, release and payment mechanics, and no-mitigation/no-offset provisions. The draft below also provides for no post-employment noncompete. Please confirm whether this resolves the remaining economic points, subject to both clients’ approval. Identity, dates, reporting arrangements, work location, governing law, and other definitive-agreement provisions remain open.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD 400,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall be eligible for an annual bonus with a target equal to 50% of annual base salary. Performance criteria, determination of actual bonus earned, payment timing, and treatment of partial years shall be expressly documented in the definitive agreement. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans on the terms applicable to similarly situated executives. Any equity compensation remains subject to separate agreement and documentation.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall pay severance equal to 12 months of the Executive’s then-current annual base salary plus one times the Executive’s then-current target annual bonus, disregarding any reduction giving rise to Good Reason. Severance shall be payable in a lump sum within 60 days following termination, subject to an executed, effective customary release of claims and any legally required payment delay. The Company shall also provide 12 months of employer-paid continuation of the Executive’s and eligible dependents’ health coverage at the level in effect immediately before termination, or its cash equivalent if continuation cannot lawfully be provided, with implementation and valuation mechanics to be specified in the definitive agreement. Severance shall not be subject to mitigation or offset. Accrued compensation and mandatory statutory entitlements shall be paid separately as required by applicable law and shall not be conditioned on a release. 'Cause' means fraud, embezzlement, conviction of a felony involving dishonesty, or willful material misconduct causing substantial harm to the Company; where curable, the Company must give written notice specifying the grounds and 30 days to cure before terminating for Cause. 'Good Reason' means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in compensation, duties, or authority; relocation of the Executive’s principal work location by more than 50 miles; or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. Good Reason requires written notice specifying the grounds within 90 days after the event, failure by the Company to cure within 30 days after receipt of that notice, and resignation within 60 days after expiration of the cure period. Release timing and payment provisions shall be finalized to comply with applicable law, including Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code to the extent applicable.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. No post-employment non-competition restriction shall apply. Any confidentiality, intellectual-property assignment, or other protective provisions remain subject to express agreement and review under applicable law, including appropriate protections for lawful reporting and other protected activity.
Executive Employment Agreement — Discussion Draft; Subject to Client Approval and Definitive Execution
